sources.title: GitHub - MichaelTMatthews/Craftax: (Crafter + NetHack) in JAX. ICML ...
sources.snippet: Craftax is an RL environment written entirely in JAX. Craftax reimplements and significantly extends the game mechanics of Crafter, taking inspiration from roguelike games such as NetHack. Craftax conforms to the gymnax interface, allowing easy integration with existing JAX-based frameworks like PureJaxRL and JaxUED.
